verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs show that items (tasks) are created on boards (a `create_item` event) and that items can be assigned, but the assignment evidence concerns agents treated 'like teammates', not human teammates. Due dates are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating tasks and assigning them to human teammates, any due-date or timeline column evidence, and hands-on corroboration of the assign-with-deadline workflow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items
90% started updating tickets once a week instead of daily
